mechanism: Disulfiram may inhibit CYP3A4-mediated metabolism of mycophenolate and potentially increase mycophenolic acid exposure, while disulfiram's hepatotoxic potential may complicate mycophenolate's hepatic metabolism.
action: Monitor for increased mycophenolate side effects (GI symptoms, myelosuppression) and consider therapeutic drug monitoring if available; assess hepatic function periodically given both agents' hepatic involvement.
